entries.text: If you have business with the Hub police, please talk to Sheriff Greene.  I only take care of his duties when the Sheriff is unavailable.
entries.source_text:
If you have business with the Hub police, please talk to Sheriff Greene.  I only take care of his duties when the
 Sheriff is unavailable.

entries.text: I can't believe the Sheriff is really dead.
entries.source_text: I can't believe the Sheriff is really dead.

entries.text: There you are.  I've been waiting for you to return.  We heard the Sheriff was killed during the battle.  It's hard to believe he's really gone.  He was like a father to me.
entries.source_text:
There you are.  I've been waiting for you to return.  We heard the Sheriff was killed during the battle.
  It's hard to believe he's really gone.  He was like a father to me.

entries.text: The Sheriff gave me instructions to carry out in the event that he did not return from the mission.  He asked me to give you the remainder of your reward.  I believe it was 1000 caps.  [The Deputy hands you 1000 caps]
entries.source_text:
The Sheriff gave me instructions to carry out in the event that he did not return from the mission.  He
 asked me to give you the remainder of your reward.  I believe it was 1000 caps.  [The Deputy hands you 1000 caps]

entries.text: This city owes you a debt of thanks.  I only wish the Sheriff could be here to thank you himself.  Goodbye.
entries.source_text: This city owes you a debt of thanks.  I only wish the Sheriff could be here to thank you himself.  Goodbye.

entries.text: Oh my God!  They killed Kenny!  Those bastards!
entries.source_text: Oh my God!  They killed Kenny!  Those bastards!
